notes:
• Trakt: your whole watch history now loads, not just the first 100 movies, so older titles get their watched marks again (also watchlist, resume points and collection)
• Dolby Atmos (DD+ Atmos) tracks are sent to the TV or soundbar as plain Dolby Digital Plus, fixing silent audio on some TVs
• Logs now list each title's audio tracks and how the sound is being played, to help with audio problems
